section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar that his father said:"One of the sunnahs of the prayer is to spread your left foot beneath you, and hold your right foot upright
